qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.lowering: The exact site reuses the production-qualified memory-SETcc emitter, which materializes the incoming flags before a final transactional byte write.
admission.boundedRule: The measured RIP, complete five-byte single instruction, SETE condition, byte width, RSP base, SIB shape, displacement 0x2f, and 64-bit address width must all match. An adjacent RIP or changed displacement declines.

verification.focusedGate: The expanded exact memory-SETE matrix passes its tier-one differential and negative-admission checks.
verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,498 tests in 175 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Both zero-flag outcomes match the interpreter for complete state and memory using the RSP+0x2f address.
verification.faultCoverage: The shared memory-SETcc matrix retains transactional final-write rollback coverage.
verification.negativeCoverage: An adjacent RIP and a changed stack displacement both decline tier one.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Exact-site absence establishes production use; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.
